record.paper_title: Open problems for the superKdV equations
record.original_question: Clarify the geometric relation between supersymmetric integrable systems and soliton theory, especially by determining the super-geometric structures associated with the super KdV equations and their super Sine-Gordon relatives.

evidence.quote: Finally, unravelling the deep relations between geometry and soliton theory has been an important theme of this workshop; little is known on the super version of this connection. In particular, the super KdV equations have super Sine-Gordon relatives and these should lead to very interesting geometrical structures.

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Background. The Korteweg–de Vries (KdV) equation u_t = u_{xxx} + 6 u u_x and the Sine-Gordon equation φ_{tx} = sin φ are classical integrable soliton equations whose theory is intimately connected with rich geometric structures (e.g., pseudo-spherical surfaces of constant negative Gaussian curvature for Sine-Gordon, and Poisson/bi-Hamiltonian structures, loop-group factorizations, and Virasoro coadjoint geometry for KdV). 

Supersymmetric ("super") extensions of these equations are formulated over a Grassmann-valued function space. For example, the N=1 super KdV equation for a bosonic field u(x,t) and a fermionic field ξ(x,t) reads
   u_t = -u_{xxx} + 6 u u_x - 3 ξ ξ_{xx},
   ξ_t = -ξ_{xxx} + 3 (u ξ)_x,
and the N=1 super Sine-Gordon equation for a bosonic field φ and a fermionic field ψ is given (in light-cone coordinates) by
   φ_{+-} = sin φ + (fermionic terms),
   together with Dirac-type equations for ψ.
Both admit Lax representations valued in suitable Lie superalgebras (e.g., osp(1|2), sl(2|1)) and possess super-Hamiltonian (super-Poisson) structures.

Problem. Provide an intrinsic super-geometric description of the N=1 (and, more generally, N=2) super KdV and super Sine-Gordon hierarchies that extends the known classical correspondences. Specifically:

(a) Identify and characterize a class of super-geometric objects (for instance, supermanifolds with a distinguished super-connection, or "super pseudo-spherical" structures on a (1|1)- or (2|2)-dimensional supermanifold with constant super-curvature) such that the integrability condition of an associated Maurer–Cartan / zero-curvature equation in the relevant Lie superalgebra reproduces the super Sine-Gordon equation, in direct analogy with the classical pseudo-spherical surfaces interpretation of Sine-Gordon.

(b) Construct the analogous super-geometric realization of the super KdV hierarchy as a Hamiltonian flow on the dual of a super-Virasoro (or appropriate Neveu–Schwarz) Lie superalgebra equipped with its natural super-Lie–Poisson bracket, and identify the super-version of the Miura/Bäcklund transformation relating super KdV and super (m)KdV in this geometric setting.

(c) Establish the precise super-geometric relationship between (a) and (b), exhibiting super KdV and super Sine-Gordon as different reductions of a common super-geometric framework, and explain the role (if any) of the fermionic directions in producing new geometric invariants (e.g., super-Schwarzian derivatives, super-flat connections, or odd symplectic/Poisson structures) that have no classical analogue.
artifact.status_search_result: Partial progress exists in the literature on individual aspects: super-Hamiltonian/bi-Hamiltonian structures for super KdV, Lax pairs and Bäcklund transformations for the super (sinh/Sine)-Gordon hierarchy, sl(2|1)- and osp(1|2)-loop-algebra constructions, and soliton solutions via Hirota's method and super-Miura transformations. However, a unified intrinsic super-geometric framework (analogous to the classical pseudo-spherical/Virasoro coadjoint pictures) tying super KdV to its super Sine-Gordon relative remains incomplete; no source claims a definitive resolution.

status_evidence.title: Supersymmetry and the KdV equations for integrable hierarchies with a half-integer gradation
status_evidence.snippet: Construction of N=2 mKdV and negative N=2 sinh-Gordon hierarchies based on sl(2|1) loop algebra with principal gradation.
status_evidence.claim: Algebraic/loop-algebraic framework relating super KdV and super sinh-Gordon exists but is not a complete super-geometric theory.

status_evidence.title: Defects in the supersymmetric mKdV hierarchy via Bäcklund transformations
status_evidence.snippet: Constructs super Bäcklund transformations for the N=1 supersymmetric mKdV hierarchy.
status_evidence.claim: Recent work continues to develop the structural theory; no global super-geometric correspondence is asserted.

status_evidence.title: Soliton Solutions for the Super mKdV and sinh-Gordon
status_evidence.snippet: Hirota-method soliton solutions for N=2 super mKdV and connection to super KdV via super Miura transformation.
status_evidence.claim: Concrete solution-level relations are known, but intrinsic geometric interpretation is not provided.
